title: Mediterranean Chicken Pasta
description: A light and flavorful Mediterranean-inspired pasta dish made with chicken, olives, and feta cheese.

ingredients.name: Light Mediterranean Pasta
ingredients.notes: Choose a gluten-free option if needed

instructions: Cook the pasta according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
Preheat the grill or oven to medium-high heat. Season the chicken breast with salt, pepper, and any desired herbs.
Grill or bake the chicken for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through to an internal temperature of 165°F.
In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the sliced olives and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until heated through.
Stir in the crumbled feta cheese and cook for 1 minute, until melted and creamy.
Toss the cooked pasta with the olive and feta mixture.
Slice the grilled chicken into thin strips and serve on top of the pasta.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.
